title: Annotated Corpus of Pre-Standardized Balkan Slavic Literature 1.1
notes: The 23-text Damaskini subcorpus (16th-19th c. Balkan Slavic, Bulgarian/Macedonian/Torlak, ~53k tokens) is exactly the resource published at CLARIN.SI handle 11356/1441 (v1.1, 2021) by the SNSF-funded ZuCoSlaV project of Ivan Simko (University of Zurich, Slavic Seminary). Mirror on UZH GitLab: https://gitlab.uzh.ch/uzh-slavic-corpora/pre-standardized-balkan-slavic-literature. Formats are TSV/CoNLL-U/plain text (not TEI). License: CC BY-SA 4.0. Origin verbatim: 'Damaskini (pre-standard Balkan Slavic), 17th c.'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: ZuCoSlaV project, Ivan Simko, University of Zurich, hosted at CLARIN.SI
